mechanics.headingCase: ALL CAPS for press headlines, ENDS, ABOUT VAUXHALL MOTORS, trim-block headings and the app image disclaimer; sentence case as the default for editorial section headings; Title Case inconsistently for a minority (Key Facts, Comfort and Practicality, New Vauxhall, Electric Streets); technology headings as 'PureSense: Intelligent safety'
mechanics.bulletPunctuation: no terminal punctuation on bullets; body sentences take full stops
mechanics.emDash: none observed - the spaced en dash does that work
mechanics.enDash: spaced en dash used for asides, ranges and as a headline separator; a spaced hyphen does the same headline job in another pack eleven days earlier
mechanics.colon: preferred headline separator and universal bullet separator
mechanics.ampersand: used freely - headlines, job titles, bullet text, sub-heads, table labels, T&Cs, Bold & Pure, stop & go
mechanics.questionMarks: none, except inside the proper noun 'What Car?'
mechanics.oxfordComma: used but not universally - present in five observed lists, absent in others (e.g. 'excludes NI, IoM and Channel Islands')
mechanics.quotationMarks: curly apostrophes and single quotes in the Astra pack; straight single quotes around a colloquialism ('pocket rockets')
mechanics.unitSpacing: units close up to the numeral with no space, without exception: 281PS, 207kW, 345Nm, 58kWh, 100kW, 355mm, 4,374mm, 105mph, 48.7mpg, 759kg, 18-inch
mechanics.percentages: numeral plus symbol, no space - 75%, 4.8%, 0% APR
mechanics.volume: 'cubic metres' written out for load space; 'litres' for boot space
mechanics.powerUnits: PS in spec tables, hp in prose, kW parenthetically after PS, bhp reserved for historic engines (100bhp on a 1987 Nova, 189bhp on a 2007 Corsa VXR)
mechanics.measurementSystem: imperial for consumer-facing distance, speed and economy (miles, mph, mpg, miles/kWh); metric for engineering (mm, kg, Nm, kWh, kW, g/km, litres, metres). No kilometres anywhere
mechanics.currency: £ closed up to the numeral; round and unpenced in body and bullets (£1,000, £32,995, £27,495); always two decimals in finance tables (£27,045.00, £130.93); sub-unit as 7p per kWh; OTR and 'On The Road Price' both in use; VAT bracketed as (incl. VAT) and (excl. VAT)
mechanics.spelling: UK throughout - colours, centre, kerb, callipers, tyres, line-up

legalAndHedging.asteriskConvention: single asterisk for one caveat, and the caveat can be extremely terse - the entire hedge on the headline price £32,995 is '*Pending government approval'
legalAndHedging.numberedFootnotes: marker rides on the last word with no space ('...new retail car customers2'); the note repeats the bare digit ('2Available across...')
legalAndHedging.tableAsterisks: explained in the header ('OTR price * After ECG') and applied to values ('£29,995 / £28,495*')
legalAndHedging.wltp: qualifies every range and economy figure, inline in brackets next to the number rather than in small print; four capitalisation variants in one document
legalAndHedging.upTo: 'up to' precedes essentially every performance or capacity figure
legalAndHedging.superlativeCompliance: superlatives are narrowed by a qualifier instead of footnoted - 'UK's best-selling supermini year-to-date', 'Most powerful production Corsa of all time', 'Fastest accelerating Vauxhall on sale', 'one of few automotive brands to produce electric vehicles in Britain'
legalAndHedging.offerSmallPrint: exhaustive and granular - names a non-participating retail group ('Arnold Clark sites are not participating retailers.'), household limits ('Only 1 claim per household permitted.'), geographic carve-outs ('Offer excludes NI, IoM and Channel Islands.')

toolingCaveat: WebFetch enforces a cap of roughly 125 characters per quoted excerpt and refused full verbatim transcription of any press release, including when asked to split text into sub-100-character lines. Short elements (headlines, bullets, footnotes, disclaimers, single quoted sentences, job titles) came back exact. Long sentences are truncated and marked [TRUNCATED]; fetcher paraphrase is marked as such. See copy/pages/00-READ-THIS-FIRST-fidelity-caveat.md.
